The selected homosporous fern lesson retains mature sporophyte with eight pinnae and eight representative sorus marks, a single spore, heart-shaped gametophyte and young fan-leaved sporophyte. Four clockwise introduced transitions are keyed as meiosis/spore release, germination, fertilisation/young sporophyte and growth. Solid badges retain two/one/one/two phase counts for diploid/haploid/haploid/diploid. Sorus and phase point marks are enlarged to 6.35 mm; the rhizome is thickened and gametophyte rhizoids share a short branching rootlet-like graphic stem as a space-saving cue, not actual tissue anatomy.
